## Menus

- **Context menu** (right-click): `--surface`, 2px `--line`, radius 14px, `--shadow-menu`, padding 6px, min-width 210px, `--fs-md` weight 700. Item padding 8px 12px, radius 9px; hover `--brand-tint` fill with `--brand` text. It pops in from 96% scale over `--t-quick`. Escape or a click outside closes it.
- **Modal:** a backdrop of `--brand` at 88% over the whole app. The box sits in the middle of the screen, 520px wide, `--surface`, radius `--r-card`, a 6px bottom edge of `#0000002e`, overflow hidden, `--text` weight 600 `--fs-md` body text, line-height 1.45. Its header is at least 56px tall, `--brand` fill with a 4px `--brand-dark` lid along its bottom (like the menu bar), padding 10px 28px 14px: the modal's 24px fill icon ([Icons](#icons)), then the title, left-aligned, in white 18px weight 900. The body has padding 28px, paragraphs 10px apart. The buttons fill the bottom row as equal tiles (a bento), gap 8px, 22px under the text, each at least 44px tall; **Cancel** is a Secondary tile. The box pops in and the backdrop fades in ([Motion](#motion)). Used for:
  - **The New Project warning** (PRD §9). Icon `plus`. Title "Start a new Project?", body "Only one Project is saved, so this one will be replaced, Blocks and all. Download code first to keep a copy of the website's code." Buttons: **Download code** (Secondary), **Cancel**, **Start a new Project** (Primary).
  - **The demo warning** (PRD-43), only if the current Project isn't empty. Icon `cake`. Title "Load the demo?", body "This replaces your current Project, Blocks and all. Download code first to keep a copy of the website's code." Buttons: **Download code** (Secondary), **Cancel**, **Load the demo** (Primary).
  - **The Checkpoint warning** (ADR 0005), before **Restore** in [Checkpoints](#checkpoints). Icon `clock-counter-clockwise`. Title "Restore Checkpoint N?". Every "Checkpoint N" here reads "Checkpoint N · <name>" when that Checkpoint has a name. Body, one paragraph per line:
    - "Your Blocks and code go back to how they were at Checkpoint N."
    - Only with changes no Checkpoint holds: "You have changes that are not in a Checkpoint."
    - Only with an Assistant change not yet accepted: "The Assistant's unaccepted changes will be dropped."
    - Buttons with changes: **Restore without saving** (Secondary), **Cancel**, **Save and restore** (Primary). Without: **Cancel**, **Restore** (Primary).
  - **The Build warning**, every time Build is pressed and a Build can run. Icon `flag`. Title "Build now?", body "Bob builds your site from the plan and takes you to the Build step." Buttons: **Cancel**, **Build** (Primary). When an Assistant change is not yet accepted (ticket 08), the body adds "The Assistant has changes you haven't accepted. Building drops them." and the Primary button reads **Build anyway**.
  - **The rename warning**, when a [Library](#library) file gets a new name. Icon `pencil-simple`. Title "Rename <file> to <new file>?", body "Code that references assets/<file> won't be updated and will break. You can ask the Assistant to fix the references." Buttons: **Cancel**, **Rename** (Primary).
  - **The delete warning**, before a [Library](#library) file is deleted. Icon `trash`. Title "Delete <file>?", body "Any code using it will break. You can ask the Assistant to fix the references.", or, when Traits use it, "N Trait(s) (<Block> › <type>, …) and any code using it will break. You can ask the Assistant to fix the references." Buttons: **Cancel**, **Delete** (Danger: `--alert-bg` fill, 2px `--alert` border and bottom edge, `--ink` weight 900, never white on tomato).
- **Custom Block color menu** (Stretch, PRD §6): title "Custom Block color" (weight 900), a row of 26px round preset swatches (2.5px white border, 1.5px `#0003` ring; the chosen one gets a 2.5px `--ink` ring), then "Any color" with a 44×26px color input.
- **Custom Block edit bar** (Stretch, PRD §6): across the top of the Canvas. `--edit-bar` fill, a 3px bottom edge of `#0000001a`, `--ink` weight 800 `--fs-md`, padding 8px 14px. Text: "Editing Custom Block "X". Changes reach all N Instances, except parts an Instance changed itself." A **Done** button on the right: `--surface`, no border, radius `--r-btn`, a 3px `#0000001f` bottom edge, padding 6px 16px, weight 900.
